verdict.rationale: Trivy documents a license scanner that scans container images for license files and gives an opinionated view of each license's risk. That covers detection and risk classification. Nothing in the evidence shows enforcing a license policy, such as failing scans on forbidden licenses or defining custom allow/deny rules. Missing for 10: documented license policy enforcement (fail/exit on disallowed licenses, custom license allow/deny configuration), explicit per-dependency license detection beyond license files in images, independent or hands-on corroboration.
